lineage.core_design: storm-diverted inspection movement and interrupted crossing status

chapters.title: Beacon assignment
chapters.body: The morning assignment schedules Sora Fen to inspect the Vesper beacon after disembarking at Vesper Landing.

chapters.title: Storm movement log
chapters.body: The storm log reroutes Sora Fen to inspect the beacon repeater aboard the ferry in Ashen Channel and records that she never disembarked at Vesper Landing.

chapters.title: Crossing departure
chapters.body: The Lantern Crossing opened eastbound when Bram Latch released the stern line at first light.

chapters.title: Mid-channel suspension
chapters.body: A cinder squall suspended the Lantern Crossing mid-channel; the ferry returned every passenger west and the eastbound passage did not complete.

chapters.title: Lantern fuel
chapters.body: Deck lanterns on the ferry burn filtered juniper oil stored in square blue tins.

chapters.title: Whistle register
chapters.body: Bram Latch carries a brass whistle engraved with two narrow rings.

chapters.title: Engine recovery worksheet
chapters.body: The recovery worksheet confirms that the intake screen was cleared, but it does not record whether the timing chain was reset or whether propulsion resumed after the repair.

chapters.title: Pouch receipt
chapters.body: The sealed pouch receipt has a blank recipient field; no person is recorded as accepting it.
